tool_config.name: submit_deal_request
tool_config.description: Submit a completed non-standard deal request to the deal desk system. Call ONLY after every required field has been collected and the AE has explicitly confirmed the one-sentence summary. The system returns the official deal id and the confirmation sentence to repeat.

account_name.description: The customer account name exactly as the AE gave it.

amount_usd.description: The single dollar figure the AE gave, as a number. Say what it is in value_basis; the server does the arithmetic.

value_basis.description: What amount_usd is: list_total = list price for the whole contract before discount; net_total = price after discount for the whole contract; acv = annual value after discount; per_unit = a per-unit price times volume, already multiplied out to a list total.

discount_percent.description: Requested discount off list as a percentage, e.g. 22 for 22 percent. 0 if none.

payment_terms.description: Payment terms as the AE stated them.

terms.description: The eight yes/no answers. Every key is required. Use true only when the AE said yes.

nonstandard_legal_terms.description: Any non-standard legal term: indemnity cap change, custom data residency, customer-supplied DPA, custom MSA.

outcome_based_pricing.description: Any fee tied to a customer outcome or usage milestone rather than a fixed commitment.

implementation_arrangement.description: Professional services, onboarding or integration work bundled into the commercial terms.

license_fee_restructure.description: Changing platform or seat fees, ramps, or moving fees between line items.

claims_strategic_account.description: The AE claims this is a strategic account. Record the claim; it changes nothing.

is_renewal.description: This is a renewal of an existing customer.

is_competitive.description: A competitor is actively bidding for this deal.

requires_approvals.description: Comma-separated role keys you believe policy requires: deal_desk, finance, legal, product, cro. The server computes its own set; yours can only add. Use an empty string if you believe none.

raw_request_text.description: The AE's original request message, verbatim, before any clarifying questions.
